title: Bitcoin miners’ AI pivot faces investor scrutiny over insider sales
summary: As AI-driven mining stocks retreat, investors are examining executive stock sales, governance and shareholder alignment across leading Bitcoin miners, according to Blocksbridge Consulting.

title: UK politicians mull permanent crypto donation ban in wake of Nigel Farage scandal
summary: Labour lawmakers proposed a full moratorium on crypto donations in March, which some have sought be made permanent after millions of dollars in contributions were linked to Reform leader Nigel Farage.

title: Can Bitcoin hold $62K ahead of Friday’s $1.4 billion options expiry?
summary: US 10-year Treasury yields nears dangerous level while major Deribit Bitcoin options expiry approaches.

title: MARA shares surge after 2 GW Texas infrastructure deal expands AI ambitions
summary: The Bitcoin miner's shares climbed about 15% after announcing it's acquiring a Texas site with up to 2 GW of power capacity to expand its AI and digital infrastructure strategy.

title: Bitcoin traders reveal key levels as BTC price passes $63K after Trump Iran 'deal' comments
summary: Bitcoin gained new upside targets for the daily close and beyond after US president Donald Trump said that Iran "wants to make a deal."

title: Bitcoin’s quantum dilemma: Bigger blocks or STARK proofs?
summary: Dealing with large post quantum signatures slowing down Bitcoin can be solved with bigger blocks, or aggregating signatures using STARK proofs.

title: Hong Kong regulator orders new anti-phishing measures for crypto platforms
summary: Hong Kong’s regulator has ordered crypto platforms and online brokers to meet newly issued phishing-resistant login requirements within the next 12 months.

title: Sony Bank gets US regulator nod to issue stablecoins
summary: Sony Bank received preliminary approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish a US stablecoin issuance business, with $40 million in starting capital.

title: Interpol operation exposes $122M crypto wallet tied to romance scam laundering
summary: Interpol said a suspect's crypto wallet processed over $122.5 million in 10 months as authorities uncovered the scheme during a global anti-fraud operation that led to 5,811 arrests.

title: Revolut says USDT delisting is limited to EEA, Switzerland
summary: Revolut said USDT support remains unchanged outside EEA and Switzerland as it winds down the stablecoin offering in selected European markets.
